status_is_not: evidence of equivalence between any two arms
why_no_registered_terminal: the registered routing evaluates gates GR0a/GR0b/GR0c/GR1/GR2/GR3 over 480 evaluations. Zero evaluations were produced, so no gate was computed and no endpoint was read. 'Could not check' is reported here as its own status, distinct from any registered outcome.

root_cause.class: bound-provider behaviour drift; not a defect in the R12 lane code, the substrate, or the cluster
root_cause.mechanism: the z.ai Anthropic-compatible channel returns an extended-thinking content block that is counted inside max_tokens. On the frozen E30-R12 prompts the thinking block consumes the entire registered per-call output budget before any text block is emitted, so the arm receives zero visible text and records EXECUTION_FAILED_MODEL_RESPONSE (an envelope carrying no model output).
root_cause.what_is_new: the design registers this signature as affecting 'the largest tasks' and registers a budget escalation to 36000 from pass 3 as the remedy, citing a pre-dispatch smoke in which the identical request at 36000 used 3669 output tokens. In execution it affected 116 of 116 failures across three arms. At the escalated budget the same cell consumed the full 36000 and still produced no parseable JSON object (510 s); a second, block-capturing run of the same cell closed at 35937 output tokens with a 161644-character thinking block and only 5895 characters of text, after 786 s. The escalated budget therefore clears the cap only marginally for the single-call arm, and ORION_ARM_TOTAL_OUTPUT_TOKEN_BUDGET is divided by the arm's call count, so F0_PARENT_FEDERATION and F2_ORION_METABOLIC_FULL would receive 12000 per call -- a third of what one call needed to close here.
root_cause.not_a_served_model_substitution: all 119 envelopes record exactly one served model id, glm-5.3, equal to the frozen value. GR0c's condition was met by every envelope written. The drift is in channel behaviour at a fixed served id, which no registered gate observes.

no_in_flight_repair_applied.candidate_found: adding {'thinking': {'type': 'disabled'}} to the request body restores a text block within the registered 6000 budget on the identical frozen prompt (775 output tokens, stop_reason end_turn, 2903 text characters)
no_in_flight_repair_applied.why_it_was_not_applied: the design's model_binding registers channel, base_url, requested_model, frozen_served_model, the served-model assertion and the per-envelope record; it registers no request-body contract. Pinning a thinking parameter after seeing the registered configuration fail is an unregistered instrument choice made post-dispatch, and 3 responses had already completed under the provider-default configuration and may not be re-rolled under the no-rescue clause. Applying it here would have produced a campaign split across two channel configurations and called the result the registered study.
